welcome_page.title: 1. Welcome to About You
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire collects basic personal, household and living-context information. Your answers help describe who participates in the study and how different urban conditions may affect daily mobility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. Your email address itself is never saved, and this questionnaire does not record your location.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

sections.title: About you, your studies and work
sections.description: A few background questions to help us understand who our participants are.

questions.text: What is your age group?
questions.help: We ask this to describe who takes part in the study. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

questions.text: What is your gender?
questions.help: We ask this to describe who takes part in the study. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

options.text: I describe myself in another way

questions.text: What is your highest completed level of education?
questions.help: We ask this to describe who takes part in the study. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

questions.text: Which of these best describe your current work or study situation? If you both study and work, you can choose two answers.
questions.help: We ask this to describe who takes part in the study. Your answer is not linked to your name.

options.text: Not working because of health problems or disability

questions.text: Do you currently work remotely (partly or fully)?

options.text: Yes (3 days or more in a week)
Yes, occasionally (1-2 days in a week)

questions.text: Do you have flexible working hours (the ability to choose or adjust your start and finish times)?

options.text: I work shifts (my hours change, but I don't choose them)

sections.title: Your household and the people you help
sections.description: Questions about the people you live with and the people you help.

questions.text: How many adults (aged 18 or older), including yourself, live in your home?
questions.help: Count everyone who lives with you, including flatmates or a live-in carer.

questions.text: How many children and teenagers under 18 live in your home?
Thinking about the income of everyone who lives with you, which of these best describes your household's economic situation?
questions.help: We ask this to describe who takes part in the study. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

options.text: We struggle to cover basic needs
We can cover basic needs, but almost nothing is left at the end of the month
We can cover basic needs and manage to save a little
We can afford most things we want with occasional extra expenses
We are financially very comfortable and can easily afford extra expenses

questions.text: Do you regularly accompany or look after someone who needs your help to get around or in daily life? You can choose more than one answer.
questions.help: We ask this to describe who takes part in the study. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

options.text: Yes, I accompany children or teenagers almost every day (e.g. to school, sports or other activities)
Yes, I accompany children or teenagers at least once a week
Yes, I help an adult who lives with me (e.g. an older relative or a person with disabilities)
Yes, I help an adult who does not live with me

questions.text: Do you have a pet at home that may generate additional walking trips (e.g. a dog)?

sections.title: Health and physical characteristics
sections.description: Questions about your health and physical characteristics that may affect how you get around.

questions.text: Do you have a health condition or limitation, even a mild one, that makes getting around more difficult for you, even if you move independently?
questions.help: We ask this to take the different physical characteristics of participants into account in the study. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

options.text: Yes, a temporary one (e.g. after an injury or surgery)
Yes, a permanent or long-term one

questions.text: When you get around, do you usually use or bring any of the following?
questions.help: We ask this to take the different physical characteristics of participants into account in the study. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

options.text: A pushchair or pram with a small child

questions.text: Do you have difficulty seeing or hearing, even with glasses or a hearing aid?
questions.help: We ask this to take the different physical characteristics of participants into account in the study. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

questions.text: What is your approximate height?
questions.help: We ask this to estimate the length of your step, which changes walking times. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

sections.title: Getting around and physical activity
sections.description: Questions about how far you can walk, how active you are and whether you drive.

questions.text: On average, how far can you go on foot, or with your mobility aid (e.g. walker or wheelchair), without needing a long break (more than 5 minutes)?

options.text: I cannot walk or move around, even with a mobility aid
I rarely walk, so I am not sure

questions.text: In a typical week, on how many days do you walk, cycle or do physical activity for at least 30 minutes in total? If you have a condition affecting your mobility, count the activity you are able to do.
How would you describe your current level of physical fitness (strength, endurance, and overall health)?

options.text: Very low (I get tired even with light effort)

questions.text: Do you hold a valid driving license? (Car, motorcycle or both)

options.text: Yes, but I no longer drive

sections.title: Where you live and go
sections.description: Questions about where you live and how you move around your city.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes your relationship to the area of this study (in Rome: Municipio XII)?
questions.help: Rome is divided into 15 Municipi, local districts each with its own council. Municipio XII is the part of Rome that includes Monteverde, Colli Portuensi and Bravetta.

options.text: I live here (even without official registered residence)
I travel here regularly for work or study (Commuter)
I come here regularly for services, healthcare or to accompany someone
I’m here temporarily for another reason (Visitor)

questions.text: If you live in Rome, in which Municipio do you live?

questions.text: Apart from Municipio XII and the Municipio where you live, which other Municipi of Rome do you go to at least once a month?

questions.text: Why do you do these activities outside your neighbourhood rather than in it?

options.text: The place I need to go to is there (e.g. my workplace, school or family)
Lack of services in my neighborhood
Poor quality of services in my neighborhood
Better prices or more choice of services elsewhere
I prefer other neighborhoods or areas

welcome_page.title: 1. Welcome to About You
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire collects basic personal, household and living-context information. Your answers help describe who participates in the study and how different urban conditions may affect daily mobility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>A few background questions to help u: Alcune domande generali per aiutarci a comprendere meglio chi partecipa allo studio.

it.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire col:
Questo questionario SmartUrbanity raccoglie informazioni di base sulla persona, sul nucleo familiare e sul contesto abitativo. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a descrivere chi partecipa allo studio e in che modo le diverse condizioni urbane possono influenzare la mobilità quotidiana. La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

de.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire col:

welcome_page.title: 1. Welcome to About You
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire collects basic personal, household and living-context information. Your answers help describe who participates in the study and how different urban conditions may affect daily mobility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>A few background questions to help u: Alcune domande generali per aiutarci a comprendere meglio chi partecipa allo studio.

it.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire col:
Questo questionario SmartUrbanity raccoglie informazioni di base sulla persona, sul nucleo familiare e sul contesto abitativo. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a descrivere chi partecipa allo studio e in che modo le diverse condizioni urbane possono influenzare la mobilità quotidiana. La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

en.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire col:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire collects basic personal, household and living-context information. Your answers help describe who participates in the study and how different urban conditions may affect daily mobility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. Your email address itself is never saved, and this questionnaire does not record your location.

fr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire col:
Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity recueille des informations générales sur vous, votre foyer et votre cadre de vie. Vos réponses nous aident à mieux comprendre qui participe à l’étude et comment différentes conditions urbaines peuvent influencer les déplacements quotidiens. La participation est volontaire.
